meta.title: PDF Ink to SVG
meta.description: Extract handwritten ink annotations from a PDF as SVG files. Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
language.label: Language
intro.title: Turn the handwriting in a PDF into SVG
intro.body: Drop in a PDF that was signed or marked up with a pen or stylus. Each drawing comes out as a crisp, scalable SVG you can download — including handwriting that has been flattened into the page.
dropzone.title: Drop a PDF here, or choose a file
dropzone.hint: You can add several PDFs at once.
option.keepPageSize: Keep page coordinates (SVG matches the full page instead of being cropped to the ink)
privacy: Your files stay on your device. Everything happens in this browser tab: the PDF is never uploaded and nothing is sent anywhere. The only things kept between visits are your theme and language choices.
results.title: Extracted ink
results.flattenedNote: Results marked {badge} were found by looking for hand-drawn-looking strokes in the page itself. Dense vector graphics, such as a chart line, can look the same — check the preview before downloading.
footer: Open source under the MIT License. Built with {pdfjs}.
badge.annotation.title: Read from a PDF ink annotation
badge.flattened.title: Recovered from stroke data drawn into the page content
status.onlyPdf: Only PDF files can be read. Choose a file that ends in .pdf.
status.allFlattened: Recovered from strokes flattened into the page, not from ink annotations.

status.someFlattened.one: {count} of them was flattened into the page rather than stored as an ink annotation.
status.someFlattened.other: {count} of them were flattened into the page rather than stored as an ink annotation.

noInk.imageNote: The pages do contain {images}, so the handwriting was most likely scanned or rasterised into one of them — that turns the strokes into pixels, which cannot be recovered as vectors. Tracing it in a drawing program is the only route from there.
noInk.none: no ink annotations and no stroke data in the page content.
noInk.noneHint: If handwriting is visible on the page, it was drawn as something this tool does not read — an embedded image, or text in a script font.
noInk.others: no ink. This PDF has {list} instead, which hold no pen strokes.
error.password: this PDF is password protected. Remove the password and try again.
error.invalid: this file is not a valid PDF or is damaged.
